#List of experience outside of "projects"

# UW-Madison Psychology Department Colloquium Committee (2022-2025)
The committee was a group of graduate students who invited and organized 4 invited 
lectures annually. 

### As committee chair (2024-2025)
- Lead committee in inviting national lecturers, tracking teammate tasks and 
deadlines as they organized all aspects of event planning: hotels, flights, 
meals, meetings, event catering, advertising, and the lecture itself 
- Communicated with psychology department chair and secretary on event logistics
(e.g. budget)
- Tracked other board members' tasks and deadlines (donor relations, advertising, 
and treasurer)
- Led committee meetings to track teammate tasks, decide on future invited speakers,
update committee on meetings with department chair/secretary/etc
- Conducted and analyzed annual survey to collect department feedback on lecture 
series (Qualtrics)
- Presented annually to incoming graduate students, advertising the committee to 
acquire new members
    
### As head of donor relations (2023)
- Applied for and received $2000+ yearly to fund invited lectures (application
included reasoning for invite, plus support letters from 3 other departments or 
organizations)
- Communicated with donors who gave $10000 per year to help fund committee: 
wrote newsletters/summaries, sent updates
- Communicated with chair on award money updates
